articles.title: Peter Byrne, Singer and Co-Founder of Naked Eyes, Dead at 74
articles.summary: Peter Byrne, a key member of the 1980s synth-pop band Naked Eyes, known for radio staples like “Always Something There to Remind Me” and “Promises, Promises,” died in Los Angeles at 74 on Sept. 14. His significant contribution to the 80s music scene left a lasting legacy in pop culture.

articles.title: West Bengal govt allots 256 acres to Jupiter Defence for large-scale integrated defence manufacturing facility
articles.summary: The West Bengal government has allotted 256 acres to Jupiter Defence for establishing a large-scale integrated defence manufacturing facility at Jangal Sundari Karmanagari. This significant initiative aims to bolster indigenous defence production and enhance self-reliance under the 'Make in India' programme. It marks a crucial step in strengthening the nation's defence industrial base and fostering local economic growth through job creation.
